description: Source code implementing control service logic for E2SM RIC, including style-specific control request handling, validation, and execution, with support for multiple control styles and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for control services, including style definition and executor management.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service
classes.description: Derived class implementing control request validation and execution for control styles 1-10.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255
classes.description: Specialized control service for style 255, supporting creation of requests from style 2 and batch execution.

methods.name: get_control_style_definition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the control style definition object based on current style ID and configuration.

methods.name: get_style_type
methods.description: Returns the style ID associated with the control service.

methods.name: add_e2sm_rc_control_action_executor
methods.description: Adds a new control action executor to the service's executor map.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Validates whether a given control request is supported based on style, format, and executor availability.

methods.name: execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request asynchronously, dispatching to the appropriate executor based on action ID.

methods.name: create_req_f1_from_req_f2
methods.description: Creates a style 1 control request from a style 2 request, used for style 255 handling.

methods.name: control_request_supported (style 255)
methods.description: Validates support for style 255 control requests, including nested style 2 requests.

methods.name: execute_control_request (style 255)
methods.description: Executes multiple control actions in parallel for style 255 requests, aggregating responses.
